attempts.exactPrompt:

findings.observation: The mature adult face preserves Zelon’s full cheeks, sharp brows with one notch, short rounded nose, wide closed mouth, skin band, and steady expression rather than becoming a generic baby or doll face.
The chibi remains unmistakably short and soft-round with an evident wider middle, compact torso, shortened legs, gentle contours, and the summon’s overall mass distribution.

Both forearms, wrists, and clenched fists are visibly enlarged and heavier than the summon’s source-relative arms and natural hands, producing the generic chibi inflation explicitly forbidden by this gate.
The lilac-and-dark split short textured crop, front sweep, shaved side, and exactly three discrete hair rings match the verified summon.

The lilac-smoke fitted vest system, pale soft shirt, broad folded collar, center clasp, high-waist trousers, divided coat hem, flexible boots, exactly three hair rings, and sole tiny nose stud remain legible without added ornament.
Original-resolution inspection places the complete hair-top-to-chin unit at approximately 34–35% of standing height, within the required 32–36% band and about 2.9 heads tall.
Exactly one subject appears; the entire oversized head and hair, both empty hands, and both feet remain fully inside generous safe margins.
The grounded wide ready-idle stance, compact silhouette, large head, split hair block, and lilac vest read clearly at combat-icon scale without a weapon.
The chibi remains an ordinary grounded mortal with no weapon, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, text, UI, logo, or supernatural effect.

attempts.retryReason: The render passes ratio, identity, body, hair, wardrobe, containment, readability, and 1-star gates, but the forearms, wrists, and fists are generically inflated beyond summon-relative proportions. This assignment authorizes no correction.
